flags.why: The example explains the defining property of a right prism instead of using the word in context.
flags.fix: Em hãy tính thể tích của hình lăng trụ đứng này. = Calculate the volume of this right prism.

flags.why: This name for a bus conductor is mainly Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([source](https://baomai.blogspot.com/2025/01/vi-sao-nguoi-mien-nam-goi-la-xe-o-lo-xe.html)).
The example defines leukaemia instead of showing the word used in context.
flags.fix: Anh ấy đang điều trị bệnh lơ xê mi. = He is being treated for leukaemia.

flags.why: The historical sword sense refers to a sharp sword associated with the Ryukyu Islands, not a jade-inlaid sword ([dictionary](https://hanzi.live/hanvi/l%C6%B0u%20c%E1%BA%A7u)).
flags.fix: a sharp sword associated with the Ryukyu Islands

flags.why: The example explains what a flowmeter does instead of using the word in context.
flags.fix: Kỹ thuật viên đã lắp lưu lượng kế vào đường ống. = The technician installed a flowmeter in the pipe.

flags.why: The gloss incorrectly includes any packaged dry food, whereas the word denotes prepared dry provisions stored for later consumption ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=l%C6%B0%C6%A1ng+kh%C3%B4)).
flags.fix: prepared dry provisions that can be stored for later consumption

flags.why: The example quotes and explains the proverb instead of applying it to a situation.
flags.fix: Bác sĩ chăm sóc mẹ tôi tận tình, đúng là lương y như từ mẫu. = The doctor cared for my mother devotedly, truly like a loving mother.
